description: Exact runtime payload the starting-initiatives agent receives in a Harbor trial. The fixed inputs below are staged from the committed repository at trial-build time; per-case instruction and synthetic fixtures are added as declared slots. The agent image itself contains none of this material. Validated by evals/harbor/scripts/posture.py, which re-checks every content digest and rejects any non-allowlisted or forbidden source.

staged.rationale: initiative organization contract; SKILL.md step 1 requires it
dependency-free D7Y CLI facade (d7y initiatives list/check)
public independent initiative checker invoked by d7y
target skill; injected only into the treatment arm

per_case_slots.instruction: case-specific instruction text resolved from the committed eval case
per_case_slots.fixtures: declared synthetic workspace files from the case's files[] list

excluded: eval definitions (evals.json) and the eval schema
the source checkout, host home, and Docker socket mounts
